annotations.title: CDM 2015 duties and HSE F10 notification

description: For a construction project in Great Britain (domestic by default): who holds the client's duties (on a domestic job they pass to the contractor, the principal contractor, or the principal designer under a written agreement), which roles must be filled (principal designer and principal contractor when there is more than one contractor), the core duties (construction phase plan, welfare, induction, health and safety file), and whether the project must be notified to HSE on form F10 (longer than 30 working days with more than 20 workers at once, or over 500 person days), with the arithmetic shown. Returns `f10_notification_needed`, `f10_answer`, `client_duties_held_by`, `roles`, `duties`, `working`, `must_confirm` and sources. Example: an extension with 4 trades, 60 working days, peak 6 on site, average 3: {"contractors":4,"duration_working_days":60,"peak_workers_on_site":6,"average_workers_on_site":3}.

average_workers_on_site.description: Typical number on site, used to estimate person days.

client_type.description: Defaults to domestic (a homeowner having work done on their own home, not as a business).

contractors.description: Firms and self-employed trades working on the project, including subcontractors. 1 if only you.

designer_agreed_to_take_client_duties.description: Domestic only: has the client a written agreement for the principal designer to take on the client duties?

duration_working_days.description: Expected length of the construction work in working days.

peak_workers_on_site.description: Most people working on site at the same time.

person_days.description: Total person days, if already known.

trade.description: Optional. The builder's own business details (Nero Trade Profile v1). Used to prefill the contractor details in notices and CDM answers and to give a stable nero_trade_ref. Not stored by Site Pack.

company_name.description: Registered company name, if a limited company.

company_number.description: Companies House number, for example 12345678 or SC123456.

display_name.description: Trading name shown to customers, for example "Oakline Building Services".

licence_body.description: Trade body or competent person scheme the business is a member of (the one used for the reference).

licence_number.description: Membership or registration number with that body.
